svg.aria-label: Three ways an Argo CD Application reaches a managed cluster: push, pull, Argo CD Agent
svg.title: Three ways an Argo CD Application reaches a managed cluster: push, pull, Argo CD Agent
svg.text: The hub Argo CD applies the manifests to the spoke
renders, diffs and syncs every cluster
receives the manifests – no Argo CD needed
Hub holds a token per cluster
ACM ships the Application, the spoke syncs it
full local instance, pulls Git and syncs
Full Argo CD on every spoke
The agent dials home and syncs the full status back
Full status and UI on the hub
OpenShift Platform Plus per agent cluster
